movelist.name: Knock Off
movelist.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

movelist.name: Rollout
movelist.effect: The user continues to use Rollout on each of its turns until they miss any target with Rollout, or are not able to hit any target with Rollout during their turn.  Each successive use of Rollout increases Rollout’s Damage Base by +4 to a maximum of DB 15.

movelist.name: Rapid Spin
movelist.effect: Rapid Spin destroys all Hazards within 5 meters, removes Leech Seeds, and removes the user’s Trapped or Stuck status. If Rapid Spin hits, the user’s speed raises 1 CS.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. This is increased to +2 Evasion while in a Sandstorm or sandy terrain. While in a Sandstorm, the user and adjacent allies do not lose Hit Points due to the Sandstorm.
